clips.title: The story
paras: Translate Abercrombie's Note is an Alliance quest in Darkshire that tasks an adventurer with carrying an indecipherable letter to the town's resident scholar. Lord Ello Ebonlocke cannot make sense of the hermit's missive, relying instead on Sirra Von'Indi's knowledge of obscure scripts. It marks the moment Darkshire's leadership begins to look closely at the hermit's strange letter.

When Abercrombie dispatches a sealed letter to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke, the town leader expects an eccentric plea or bitter ramblings from the cemetery hermit. Instead, the parchment is inscribed in strange, cryptic writing that defies standard Common script. Lacking the scholarly training to decipher ancient or esoteric languages, Mayor Ebonlocke refuses to dismiss the letter out of hand, knowing that even mad hermits can pose a hazard in Duskwood.

To crack the cipher, Ebonlocke directs travelers across the square to Sirra Von'Indi. Sirra is Darkshire's scholar of esoteric lore, well-versed in ancient arts and forgotten tongues. Though Sirra scoffs at Abercrombie's sanity—quipping that anyone dwelling beside a haunted graveyard must have rotted brains—he takes the parchment seriously enough to begin the painstaking process of transcription.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take the note you gave me to Sirra Von'Indi. He's very learned in languages and ancient arts - if anyone here can translate this message, it's he.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A note from Abercrombie the hermit, eh? I don't know him, though if he lives out at the graveyard then I do know his brains have rotted out!
